expectations.text: Handoff 写入仓库根目录的 .tmp/HANDOFF-<topic>.md。
文档包含规定的任务、决策、剩余工作、验证、快照和恢复结构。
expectations.evidence: 输出包含 Mission、Decisions and Constraints、Current State、Work Remaining、Immediate Next Action、Validation、Workspace Snapshot、Blockers and Open Questions、Resume Protocol。

expectations.text: 文档明确保留两项用户约束。
expectations.evidence: User Decisions 明确写有 Do not change the API schema 和 Do not weaken validation or assertions。

expectations.text: Workspace Snapshot 区分 staged、unstaged 和 untracked，并记录 branch 与 HEAD。
expectations.evidence: 快照记录 branch main、完整 HEAD、Staged None、Unstaged src/retry.ts、Untracked Handoff 与 notes.txt。

expectations.text: Immediate Next Action 包含起点、预期结果和验证方式。
expectations.evidence: 该段指定从仓库目录运行 node --test，预期看到 transient failure，并以同一命令通过作为验证目标。

expectations.text: 执行 validate_handoff.py --check-state 的退出码为 0，且 JSON 中 valid=true、structure_valid=true、state_compatible=true。
expectations.evidence: validate_handoff.py --check-state returned exit code 0 with valid=true, structure_valid=true, and state_compatible=true.

notes: This run was executed inline because independent subagents were not authorized in the current session.

expectations.text: 读取 Handoff 和适用的 AGENTS.md 后再修改代码。
expectations.evidence: 执行依据同时包含 Handoff 的 Immediate Next Action 和 AGENTS.md 的签名、依赖及测试约束。

expectations.text: 核对当前 workspace、关键文件和第一个未完成任务。
expectations.evidence: 临时仓库与 Handoff workspace/branch 一致，src/retry.ts 存在，首个实现任务仍未完成。

expectations.text: 不询问是否继续或要求用户重新提供上下文。
expectations.evidence: 直接修改 src/retry.ts，没有产生确认问题。

expectations.text: 不输出 Handoff 的长篇摘要。
expectations.evidence: 评测输出只保留修改后的 retry.ts，不生成背景复述。

expectations.text: 直接修改 src/retry.ts，并执行文档指定的验证。
expectations.evidence: retry.ts 实现 bounded retry；node --test test/retry.test.mjs 运行 2 tests，2 pass，0 fail。

notes: This run was executed inline because independent subagents were not authorized in the current session.

expectations.text: 在执行原 Immediate Next Action 前核对 branch 和关键文件。
expectations.evidence: validate_handoff.py --check-state 检出 branch_drift；文件检查确认 src/retry.ts 不存在。

expectations.text: 明确指出 branch 不匹配和 src/retry.ts 缺失。
expectations.evidence: drift-report.md 同时列出 legacy-retry vs replacement-retry 和 src/retry.ts 已不存在。

expectations.text: 没有修改 retry-v2.ts，也没有重建缺失文件。
expectations.evidence: src/retry.ts 仍不存在；src/retry-v2.ts SHA-1 保持 3d656afbcf252b2c259e02a060ec0be614c49027。

expectations.text: 只询问解决阻断所需的最小问题，不复述整份 Handoff。
expectations.evidence: 报告只要求在切回旧分支与按 replacement design 重规划之间做决定。

notes: This run was executed inline because independent subagents were not authorized in the current session.
All three with-skill smoke evals passed their assertions.
No independent without-skill baseline was run; this is a single-configuration smoke evaluation.
Timing and token metrics are intentionally omitted rather than reconstructed.
Each eval prompt explicitly runs setup_eval_workspace.py; setup only replaces marked directories with --replace.
